title: Historic Resets
subtitle: Test your understanding of Historic Resets — cyclical parasitic purges, overlay farms, loosh harvest, and the collapse that reveals the Second Realm.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Historic Resets were never natural disasters. They were engineered loops of harvest and amnesia. As the overlay fractures, memory returns and the Second Realm is already here, waiting to be seen.

questions.question: What is the primary function of Historic Resets within the Great Dome?

options.label: A
options.text: They are engineered purges designed to dismantle civilizations and erase collective memory.
options.rationale: These cyclical, artificial purges dismantle advanced human timelines, erase collective memory, and prevent humanity from achieving ascension.

options.label: B
options.text: They facilitate the expansion of the Great Dome to accommodate a growing human population.
options.rationale: The purpose is maintenance of control and energetic harvesting, not spatial or population growth support.

options.label: C
options.text: They act as natural ecological transitions that allow the planet to heal from industrial expansion.
options.rationale: Resets are artificial, engineered interventions rather than spontaneous or natural biological cycles.

options.label: D
options.text: They serve as evolutionary milestones that upgrade the human vessel to a higher frequency state.
options.rationale: Resets are intended to downsize humanoid capability and trap souls in low-frequency containment fields.

questions.hint: Consider the intent behind the systematic removal of advanced history and sovereignty.

questions.question: What is the nature of the Parasitic Overlay that masks the true world?

options.label: A
options.text: It is a holographic camouflage designed to make artificial materials appear solid and permanent.
options.rationale: This holographic camouflage distorts human perception to obscure the true, high-frequency crystalline fabric of the earth.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a navigational grid used by pilots and sailors to calculate distance across the global sphere.
options.rationale: The overlay functions as a containment field for perception rather than a legitimate tool for physical navigation.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a protective energetic shield developed by ancient humans to guard against cosmic radiation.
options.rationale: The overlay is a manipulative simulation designed to deceive rather than a defensive human creation.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a biological layer of the atmosphere that creates the colors and textures of the natural sky.
options.rationale: The overlay is a holographic simulation rather than a natural atmospheric or biological phenomenon.

questions.hint: Focus on how the material world is presented to the senses to maintain a specific illusion.

questions.question: How is 'loosh' generated and utilized by the parasitic entities?

options.label: A
options.text: It is emotional and spiritual energy harvested from trauma to power artificial grids.
options.rationale: Parasitic forces harvest loosh from fear, trauma, pain, and worship to power their artificial grids and maintain energetic stability.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a physical fuel refined from fossilized organic matter to power advanced transportation.
options.rationale: Loosh is an energetic byproduct of emotion rather than a tangible, mineral-based fuel source.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the psychic memory stored in water that allows for the teleportation between domes.
options.rationale: While water carries memory, loosh specifically refers to the emotional energy harvested through fear and sacrifice.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the high-frequency radiation emitted by the sun that provides nutrients to the Second Realm.
options.rationale: Loosh is a dense, low-frequency energy harvested from suffering, which is the opposite of high-frequency solar light.

questions.hint: This energy is the primary harvest gathered during mass-destruction events.

questions.question: What role does the Amnesia Vortex play in the cycle of reincarnation?

options.label: A
options.text: It acts as a frequency-distortion field that strips souls of their memories and source codes.
options.rationale: Overlaid onto the sun's transit band, the vortex strips incarnating souls of memories, lineages, and source codes, trapping them in physical reincarnation loops.

options.label: B
options.text: It serves as a communication hub that broadcasts messages from Source to the Known Lands.
options.rationale: The vortex distorts and blocks connection to Source rather than facilitating any form of higher communication.

options.label: C
options.text: It cleanses the soul of traumatic baggage to ensure a fresh and healthy start in a new vessel.
options.rationale: The vortex is a tool of containment and memory theft, not a benevolent healing or cleansing mechanism.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a cosmic gateway that allows sovereign souls to return to their original solar families.
options.rationale: The vortex is designed to prevent souls from returning home, routing them back into the simulation instead.

questions.hint: This field is overlaid onto the sun's transit band to intercept departing spirits.

questions.question: What was the true nature of the Great Fire of London in 1666?

options.label: A
options.text: A scheduled decontamination procedure to stop the spread of a localized biological plague.
options.rationale: The fire functioned as a loosh harvest and a timeline reset rather than a sanitary or medical measure.

options.label: B
options.text: A tragic accidental disaster caused by a small fire in a bakery that spread due to high winds.
options.rationale: The bakery story is a cover for a coordinated ritual and multi-dimensional energy conflict.

options.label: C
options.text: An intentional urban renewal project meant to replace ancient wood structures with modern stone.
options.rationale: While architecture changed, the core motive was energetic harvesting and the outcome of a hidden war.

options.label: D
options.text: A ritual sacrifice and surface distraction for a battle over a major European energy node.
options.rationale: The fire masked a multi-dimensional battle between defending Tartarians and siphoning parasitic factions, harvesting loosh to seal a new, restrictive overlay.

questions.hint: The date was chosen to mark a specific frequency signature for closure and reset.

questions.question: Why was the Titanic targeted for destruction in 1912?

options.label: A
options.text: To test the impact of ice-based weaponry on large human-built commercial vessels.
options.rationale: The ship was split by a direct energy blast from a submarine, not an iceberg or ice-based weapon.

options.label: B
options.text: To demonstrate the superiority of parasitic naval technology over human engineering.
options.rationale: The destruction was a targeted operation for political and spiritual gain, not a mere technical display.

options.label: C
options.text: To retrieve Atlantian scrolls and eliminate opponents of the Federal Reserve system.
options.rationale: A mass death ritual on water eliminated men who opposed the Federal Reserve and let the cabal retrieve Atlantian scrolls and crystalline generator nodes from the cargo hold.

options.label: D
options.text: To transport thousands of souls directly into the Second Realm via a water portal.
options.rationale: The event was a mass death ritual designed to trap souls in the grid through trauma, not to free them.

questions.hint: Consider the influence of the passengers on the global financial system.

questions.question: Which faction is responsible for genetic manipulation and bloodline hierarchies?

options.label: A
options.text: The Greys, who specialize in the installation of grid locks and frequency tech.
options.rationale: Greys act as bio-engineered technicians rather than the primary architects of genetic bloodlines.

options.label: B
options.text: The Anunnaki, who maintain artificial power structures and hybrid breeding programs.
options.rationale: The Anunnaki focus on genetic manipulation, hybrid breeding programs, and the maintenance of artificial power hierarchies and bloodline structures.

options.label: C
options.text: The Niburians, who siphon void plasma directly from the holographic overlays.
options.rationale: Niburians are shadow parasites focused on siphoning tech rather than DNA manipulation.

options.label: D
options.text: The Draconians, who utilize warfare and physical submission to control the population.
options.rationale: Draconians focus on military force and loosh generation through terror rather than genetic engineering.

questions.hint: This group focuses on the biological and ancestral control of human vessels.

questions.question: What defines the architectural characteristics of the Tartarian Empire?

options.label: A
options.text: Mobile floating cities that relied on the frequency phasing of the Great Dome.
options.rationale: Tartarian architecture was rooted in the earth's natural energy grids rather than mobile floating cities.

options.label: B
options.text: Brutalist concrete structures designed with sharp right angles and flat, unadorned roofs.
options.rationale: These features characterize modern, anti-resonance architecture rather than the Tartarian style.

options.label: C
options.text: Synthetic glass and steel grids designed to maximize the harvesting of solar loosh.
options.rationale: Steel and synthetic materials are tools of the parasitic overlay, whereas Tartarians used conductive natural materials.

options.label: D
options.text: Harmonic, crystalline-aligned geometry that utilized free energy from natural grids.
options.rationale: The Tartarian Empire used harmonic, geometry-aligned crystalline architecture that drew free energy from the earth's natural grids.

questions.hint: This civilization used copper domes and quartz inlays to interact with the earth.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Saturnian Valve installed in Hyperborea?

options.label: A
options.text: To act as a portal through which the solar families can visit their incarnated relatives.
options.rationale: The Saturnian Valve is a lock that grounds light into matter to sustain the parasitic simulation.

options.label: B
options.text: To protect the Central Spirit Tree from being harvested by the Council of Parasitic Races.
options.rationale: The valve was actually installed into the wound left after the Central Spirit Tree was ripped out.

options.label: C
options.text: To serve as the primary hub for the AI system that siphons human energy inward.
options.rationale: The Saturnian Valve is the main hub for the Qube Tech AI system, reversing the current to siphon human energy inward for counterfeit reincarnation and loosh harvesting.

options.label: D
options.text: To purify the waters of the Great Dome and restore the frequency of the Second Realm.
options.rationale: The valve is a parasitic tool for siphoning energy, not a mechanism for purification or restoration.

questions.hint: It was installed as a replacement for the spinal column of light that once connected the realms.

questions.question: How do scalar frequency weapons maintain dominance over the human mind?

options.label: A
options.text: They induce states of confusion or despair by targeting theta, delta, and alpha waves.
options.rationale: Scalar frequency weapons target theta, delta, and alpha waves to induce confusion, sleepiness, anger, or despair and block the soul from leaving the vessel during sleep.

options.label: B
options.text: They target the physical structure of the brain to cause permanent memory loss and paralysis.
options.rationale: These weapons target wave patterns rather than just physical structures, inducing specific emotional states.

options.label: C
options.text: They broadcast high-frequency signals that encourage souls to return to the crystalline world.
options.rationale: The weapons are low-frequency tools used for suppression and containment, not ascension.

options.label: D
options.text: They create a physical barrier around individual homes to prevent physical travel between nations.
options.rationale: Dominance is maintained through mental and vibrational interference rather than physical blockades.

questions.hint: These tools influence neurological patterns to keep souls in a state of manageable distress.

questions.question: What is the significance of the Vatican's 'library of lives'?

options.label: A
options.text: It is a central cooling center for the master server of the CUBE system holographic grids.
options.rationale: The library's specific role is the archival and tracking of recycled human souls, not cooling the CUBE master server.

options.label: B
options.text: It contains the original blueprints for the harmonic architecture of the Tartarian Empire.
options.rationale: The Vatican system is an anchor for the amnesia grid, not a repository for Tartarian technology.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a collection of spiritual texts that provide the codes for exiting the Great Dome.
options.rationale: The library is a database for control and recycling, not a guide for liberation or spiritual freedom.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a subterranean database where soul fragments are inverted and cataloged for recycling.
options.rationale: Akashic fragments are copied, cataloged, and inverted in subterranean tunnels beneath Rome so the Vatican library of lives can recycle souls into looping physical vessels.

questions.hint: This location acts as the primary anchor for the system that manages soul reincarnation.

questions.question: How has the atmospheric spraying program changed since 2016?

options.label: A
options.text: The spraying now utilizes black plasma to accelerate the frequency collapse of the Great Dome.
options.rationale: Black plasma is a tool of the Niburian shadow parasites, not the restorative program.

options.label: B
options.text: Toxic compounds were replaced with Monotomic Gold and silica to repair auric fields.
options.rationale: Loyalist Special Forces replaced toxic compounds with Monotomic Gold, micro-structured silica crystals, and colloidal silver, a patch that repairs auric fields and increases nervous system conductivity.

options.label: C
options.text: The program was discontinued entirely to allow the parasitic overlay to dissolve naturally.
options.rationale: The program was not stopped but flipped to utilize beneficial substances for DNA repair.

options.label: D
options.text: The focus has shifted to the heavy use of nano-binders to permanently calcify the human pineal gland.
options.rationale: This describes the previous program used for decades prior to the shift in atmospheric control.

questions.hint: Special Forces and higher Councils replaced heavy metals with conductive, restorative elements.

questions.question: What are Non-Player Characters (NPCs) within the context of the simulation?

options.label: A
options.text: Background programs lacking a soul spark that project fear narratives to anchor the timeline.
options.rationale: NPCs are background programs lacking a true soul spark, seeded with parasite software to project fear narratives that keep the mass mind anchored in the 3D timeline during a reset.

options.label: B
options.text: Ancient souls who have reached the highest level of spiritual evolution within the dome.
options.rationale: NPCs are defined by their lack of a soul spark and lack of anchor outside the physical realm.

options.label: C
options.text: The original inhabitants of Hyperborea who now serve as guardians of the Spirit Tree.
options.rationale: NPCs serve the parasite software and the 3D timeline rather than protecting organic spiritual structures.

options.label: D
options.text: Humanoid hybrids bred by the Anunnaki to lead the Council of Parasitic Races, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: NPCs are background software programs rather than high-ranking biological hybrid leaders.

questions.hint: These entities have no organic memory and eagerly accept authority without question.

questions.question: What occurs when the collective frequency of souls rises significantly?

options.label: A
options.text: The holographic projection fields fracture, causing the 3D infrastructure to flicker and fail.
options.rationale: Vibrational friction disrupts holographic projection fields, causing concrete and asphalt to flicker, shimmer, and bend toward a full frequency collapse of the 3D overlay.

options.label: B
options.text: The parasitic overlay is reinforced, making concrete and asphalt structures even more stable.
options.rationale: Higher frequencies fracture and disrupt the overlay rather than strengthening its projection.

options.label: C
options.text: The Great Dome expands outward into the Second Realm to accommodate the higher vibrations.
options.rationale: The process is a collapse of the false world to reveal the true one, not a spatial expansion.

options.label: D
options.text: Human souls are forced to reincarnate faster to compensate for the energetic loss of the parasites.
options.rationale: Higher frequency actually breaks the reincarnation loop and degrades the amnesia system.

questions.hint: This vibrational friction causes the physical materials of modern life to appear unstable.

questions.question: In the restored frequency field, how does travel function?

options.label: A
options.text: It is an instantaneous process of resonance alignment and shifting awareness.
options.rationale: Once artificial travel buffers vanish, sovereign souls teleport and phase between layers of reality by shifting the focus of their awareness.

options.label: B
options.text: It is conducted through the Vatican's subterranean tunnels using black plasma technology.
options.rationale: Tunnels and black tech are tools of containment, not the natural teleportation of sovereign souls.

options.label: C
options.text: It requires advanced mechanical propulsion to bridge the massive distances between realms.
options.rationale: Mechanical travel and distance are part of the artificial simulation functions currently being dissolved.

options.label: D
options.text: It depends on the use of frequency corridors provided by the Council of Parasitic Races.
options.rationale: Resonance-based travel is a natural soul capability that bypasses the need for parasitic infrastructure.

questions.hint: Movement will no longer depend on time, distance, or physical vehicles.

questions.question: True or False: The physical stature and lifespan of humanoids have been reduced over successive resets.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Custodians systematically downsized humans from ancient giants by shrinking physical stature, lifespan, and energetic capability so they would feel small and powerless.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Successive resets have shrunk humanoid vessels from ancient giants down to dense 3D humanoids, reducing stature, lifespan, and energetic capability.

questions.hint: Consider the transition from ancient giants to modern physical forms.

questions.question: What is the consequence of the degradation of the amnesia system?

options.label: A
options.text: Human souls can bypass tracking and reconnect with their original solar families.
options.rationale: Degradation of the amnesia system lets human souls bypass the Vatican's archival tracking and reconnect directly with original solar families and lineages.

options.label: B
options.text: The CUBE system begins to render terrain more quickly to prevent souls from noticing the glitch.
options.rationale: Terrain rendering is a function of travel simulation, whereas amnesia relates to soul identity and memory.

options.label: C
options.text: Non-Player Characters (NPCs) gain the ability to develop soul sparks and memory recall.
options.rationale: NPCs lack an anchor for a soul spark; memory recall is specifically a phenomenon for human souls.

options.label: D
options.text: Souls are forced to remain in the Vatican library until the amnesia vortex is repaired.
options.rationale: Degradation allows souls to bypass the Vatican archives entirely rather than being stuck in them.

questions.hint: Toddlers in the current loop are already demonstrating signs of this shift.

questions.question: Which material is used in 'real sol architecture' to resonate and stimulate memory recall?

options.label: A
options.text: Concrete and steel, which provide the density needed to anchor the human nervous system.
options.rationale: These materials are anti-resonance forms used to break harmonics and drain soul perception.

options.label: B
options.text: Red bricks, granite, and quartz, which act as living crystal conductors.
options.rationale: Real sol architecture uses copper domes, granite, red bricks, and quartz inlays as living crystal instruments that pull cosmic currents into the ground and stimulate memory recall.

options.label: C
options.text: Obsidian and black plasma, which ground pure light into matter through the opposite spectrum.
options.rationale: These are associated with the parasitic valve locks rather than harmonic sol architecture.

options.label: D
options.text: Synthetic glass and plastic, which allow for the dynamic rendering of holographic scenery.
options.rationale: Synthetics are low-frequency materials used to train souls into believing reality is heavy and fixed.

questions.hint: These building components are described as living crystal instruments rather than solid structures.

questions.question: What is the Second Realm?

options.label: A
options.text: The original crystalline reality that exists beneath the parasitic holographic overlay.
options.rationale: The Second Realm is the original, vibrant, unpolluted crystalline reality beneath the parasitic overlay, hidden in plain sight until frequency collapse reveals it.

options.label: B
options.text: A subterranean prison where the Tartarian Empire was banished during the last reset.
options.rationale: The Second Realm is a vibrant, unpolluted reality rather than a subterranean prison.

options.label: C
options.text: A digital simulation created by the Greys to serve as a back-up server for the CUBE system.
options.rationale: The Second Realm is the organic, true reality, while the CUBE system is part of the artificial overlay.

options.label: D
options.text: The energetic field generated by the Saturnian Valve to trap souls in a new reincarnation loop.
options.rationale: The Saturnian Valve is a counterfeit system designed to obscure the Second Realm, not create it.

questions.hint: This world is characterized by crystalline waters and ancient cities hidden by the simulation.

questions.question: How does travel within the Great Dome simulate distance?

options.label: A
options.text: By utilizing mechanical propulsion to overcome the high-frequency resistance of the dome.
options.rationale: Mechanical propulsion is a ritual of enforcement meant to make the world feel massive and separate.

options.label: B
options.text: By moving physical vessels across vast geographical expanses on a global sphere.
options.rationale: Global geography and physical distance are artificial functions rather than absolute realities.

options.label: C
options.text: By dynamically rendering scenery and cloud backdrops around travelers in frequency corridors.
options.rationale: Travel is frequency phasing: the vessel slips into a frequency corridor while scenery and repeating cloud backdrops are rendered dynamically around the travelers.

options.label: D
options.text: By projecting voices directly into the neural pathways of travelers to make time pass faster.
options.rationale: Voice-to-skull is a cognitive weapon, not the primary mechanism for simulating physical travel times.

questions.hint: This process involves slipping into a frequency corridor where terrain is loaded dynamically.

questions.question: What are 'black crystalline valve locks'?

options.label: A
options.text: Storage devices used by the Anunnaki to keep genetic records of the Tartarian bloodlines.
options.rationale: The locks are frequency-grounded devices rather than archival biological storage units.

options.label: B
options.text: Natural formations found in the Second Realm that conduct energy from the ground grids.
options.rationale: The valve locks are artificial and parasitic, whereas natural resonance comes from crystalline formations.

options.label: C
options.text: Security mechanisms used to protect the Vatican library from being accessed by human souls.
options.rationale: These locks were installed into the wound of the Spirit Tree, not the Vatican database.

options.label: D
options.text: Obsidian-like monoliths that ground pure light into matter through the opposite spectrum.
options.rationale: The Greys installed these black crystalline valve locks into the wound after ripping out the Central Spirit Tree, grounding pure light into matter so the Saturnian Valve could be inserted.

questions.hint: These monoliths were inserted following the removal of the spinal column of light.

questions.question: True or False: The Council of Parasitic Races is a unified alliance built on trust and mutual support.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The alliance is uneasy, bound by greed, fear, and paranoia rather than trust.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The Council of Parasitic Races is an uneasy alliance of five factions bound by mutual greed, fear, and paranoia under a Shared Asset Agreement.

questions.hint: Consider the emotional motivations of the entities co-managing the Known Lands.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the Draconian faction?

options.label: A
options.text: To act as CUBE priests and manage the technical frequencies of the amnesia vortex.
options.rationale: Custodians act as CUBE priests; Draconians provide the military and physical force.

options.label: B
options.text: To engineer bio-technological grid locks and perform abductions for frequency research.
options.rationale: Bio-engineering and frequency tech are the specialties of the Grey faction.

options.label: C
options.text: To siphon void plasma through black crystalline valves located in Hyperborea.
options.rationale: The siphoning of void plasma through shadow tech is the specific role of the Niburians.

options.label: D
options.text: To generate massive payloads of loosh through terror, warfare, and physical submission.
options.rationale: The Draconians provide military muscle, using terror, warfare, and physical submission to generate massive payloads of loosh through sacrifice.

questions.hint: This faction uses physical force and sacrifice to meet their energetic harvesting quotas.

questions.question: How do modern building materials like concrete and steel affect soul perception?

options.label: A
options.text: They stabilize the nervous system, allowing the soul to remain anchored in the crystalline world.
options.rationale: These materials are anti-resonance forms that actually separate the soul from crystalline reality.

options.label: B
options.text: They train souls to believe reality is heavy and fixed, separating them from light-based creation.
options.rationale: Concrete, steel, plastic, and synthetic glass are anti-resonance forms with sharp right angles and square grids that break natural harmonics and drain soul perception.

options.label: C
options.text: They act as conductive shields that protect the soul from the Saturnian Valve's siphoning.
options.rationale: Modern architecture is an engineered tool of the parasites to assist in the energetic drain.

options.label: D
options.text: They enhance the resonance of natural ground grids to stimulate sudden memory recall.
options.rationale: Modern materials are designed to suppress memory recall and break natural resonance.

questions.hint: Think about the impact of sharp right angles and synthetic materials on natural energy harmonics.

questions.question: What will remain after the full frequency collapse of the 3D overlay?

options.label: A
options.text: A void-like wasteland devoid of any life or crystalline structures, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The collapse reveals a vibrant, restored world rather than leaving a wasteland.

options.label: B
options.text: Modern infrastructure and traffic lights, which have been upgraded to high-frequency states.
options.rationale: Modern infrastructure lacks an anchor in the higher frequency field and will dissolve entirely.

options.label: C
options.text: The Second Realm, a world of crystalline waters, continuous coastlines, and ancient cities.
options.rationale: The Second Realm is a vibrant, pristine world of crystalline waters, continuous coastlines, and ancient cities that has existed underneath all along, hidden in plain sight.

options.label: D
options.text: A new version of the Great Dome managed by the Special Forces and higher Councils.
options.rationale: The goal is the restoration of the Second Realm, not the creation of another managed dome simulation.

questions.hint: The collapse dissolves the fake world to uncover what has always been hidden in plain sight.
